schema:name: Facility Registry
schema:description:
Facility Registry (health facilities metadata system): Maintains metadata about health facilities such as name, type, ownership, location, services offered, operational status, identifiers, and contact details. Supplies metadata on source facilities contributing data; supports data provenance and verification.
